newsitem.title: USA: MGE March spring wheat ends lower on hedge selling.
newsitem.headline: MGE March spring wheat ends lower on hedge selling.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mixed with nearby March lower on hedge selling.
"There was hedge selling again in the March," a trader said.
Country Hedging was an early seller of up to 400,000 bushels of March, traders said. Atwood Peavey was a late seller of 500,00 to 600,000 bushels of March, they said.
Also the market was pressured by slack exports with USDA's weekly export inspections tally for wheat at a level well below expectations.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 3/4 cent lower to two cents higher, with March down 3/4 at $4.16-1/4 a bushel.
